'''2013 World Championship''' was the 18th Star Wars CCG World Championship, run by the [[Players Committee]] in Boston, Massachusetts, on 9–11 August 2013.<ref name="awards" /><ref name="tdl" /> The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.3]]. 60 players took part.<ref name="wp" /> [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Reid Smith]] in the final, playing Imperial Occupation and It Is The Future You See (V) on Day 3.<ref name="awards" /> On 10 August, Day 2 of the event, the Players Committee enshrined its first Hall of Fame class: [[Jonny Chu]], [[Angelo Consoli]], Desai and [[Kevin Shannon]]; Desai won the title the next day.<ref name="awards" /> Decklists survive for all three days.<ref name="tdl" />

== Results ==

Desai and Smith are placed from the published final.<ref name="awards" /> The order of the other Day 3 players has not been found, so they are shown as 3–8. Only seven Day 3 players are known; the eighth has not been identified. Decks are the Day 3 lists. Remaining Day 3 Xerox and typed Print Form sheets are in [[:File:2013 Worlds Day 3.pdf]]. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] Day 2 Walkers / Communing Xerox sheets were bound into that PDF (pages 9–10).

== Side events ==

=== Hall of Fame ===

The inaugural Players Committee Hall of Fame class was enshrined on 10 August 2013, during the World Championship: [[Jonny Chu]], [[Angelo Consoli]], [[Justin Desai]] and [[Kevin Shannon]].<ref name="awards" /> Hall of Famers receive an automatic berth into Day 2 of every later World Championship.<ref name="awards" />
